page_title: Respan - Route, monitor, and evaluate every agent run

sources.entry: Keywords AI - The enterprise-grade software to build, monitor, and improve your AI application. Keywords AI is a full-stack LLM engineering platform for developers and PMs.

summary.name: Respan
summary.one_liner: Respan (formerly Keywords AI, per the listing) is an AI router and LLM engineering platform that routes requests to many models through one API and adds tracing, monitoring, and automated evals.
use_cases: route requests across many LLM providers through one endpoint
automatic failover when a model errors or is rate-limited
trace and debug agent runs step by step
run evals on test sets and production traffic before shipping prompts or models
monitor LLM cost, latency, and error rates with alerts
set budgets and rate limits per key or customer
summary.what_it_does: Respan provides a gateway that sends requests from existing SDKs to a single endpoint reaching 1,000+ models, with automatic fallbacks, response caching, and budgets or rate limits at key, customer, or org scope. Its evals feature lets users grade outputs with an LLM judge, a code check, or a human reviewer, build test datasets from production logs or CSV uploads, and compare prompt or model versions by score. Monitoring tracks requests, errors, cost, latency, and tokens on one dashboard and sends alerts to Slack, email, or a webhook when a threshold is crossed. Tracing records LLM calls, tool runs, retrievals, and agent turns as spans in one trace, including inputs, outputs, latency, and cost. The page also lists ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance, with a BAA available for healthcare teams.
notable: Single OpenAI-style endpoint routing to 1,000+ models with automatic fallbacks
Evaluators combining LLM judges, code checks, and human review, run on datasets or live production spans
Per-span tracing of agent steps with inputs, outputs, latency, and cost
Lists ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the page only mentions 'the best deals' in general terms
Platform support beyond the web is not described on the page
Customer testimonials and logos are marketing material and were not used as facts
